comment: The veraPDF release that scripts/InstallVeraPdf.cs installs for the PDF/A tests. Renovate updates it from the veraPDF/veraPDF-apps release tags. testFilesCommit pins the commit of veraPDF's PDF/A test files (the veraPDF-corpus repository) that scripts/FetchVeraPdfTestFiles.cs fetches; after changing either value, rerun scripts/RecordVeraPdfResults.cs. profilesCommit pins the commit of veraPDF's validation profiles (the veraPDF-validation-profiles repository) that scripts/FetchVeraPdfProfiles.cs fetches for the tagged PDF and WCAG agreement tests; after changing it, rerun scripts/StandardsRuleTableGenerator.cs.
